content:
ellie: Heads-up — we need a short runbook for the SI co-sell + marketplace listing sync. HW partner wants joint announce w/ marketplace tile the week of the 14th. Who owns lead routing and the account mapping rules?
ramon: I can take lead routing. quick q: are hardware-influenced accounts treated differently from pure software leads?
nicole: Yes — for co-sell with HW partners we treat them as "marketplace-influenced" and route to the assigned SI if account fit matches. TTL to claim is important.
alex: From legal: any joint announce needs a 7-day review window and approved joint messaging. Please tag legal on the draft.
sanjay: For orchestration: propose these minimum rules (can we agree?):
```
1) Lead tags: marketplace=true hw_partner=ACME
2) Claim window: 72h for SI to claim, then fallback to Redwood AE queue
3) If multi-SI match -> region prioritization, then last-touch scoring
4) Joint announce draft -> shared Confluence + legal review (7d)
```
ellie: That looks good. Add: pre-announce marketplace listing date must be pinned in sheet and not be changed without partner sign-off.
ramon: Spreadsheet link: https://docs.google.com/sheet/d/1XyzMarketPlaceSync (please request view access)
nicole: I'll prepare a cheat-sheet for SDRs: quick fields to surface (hw_model, marketplace_tile_id, SI_owner, claim_by_ts). Short 1-pager is enough.
partners-bot: New doc created: "SI Co-sell & Marketplace Orchestration" https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PRTNRS/SI+Co-sell+Marketplace+Orchestration
alex: Also flag certifications: if SI requires HW cert, we add a "cert_needed" flag — that blocks auto-claiming until validated.
sanjay: Action items: @ramon owns lead routing config; @nicole owns SDR cheat-sheet + SLA doc; @alex will prep legal checklist; @ellie will own joint announce timeline and partner sign-off. I'll centralize in the Confluence doc.
ellie: Perfect. Quick timeline: drafts by EOD Fri, legal review Mon, partner sign-off Tue, marketplace tile live Thurs. If anyone can't hit those, call it out now.
ramon: I can do routing config by Thu EOD.
nicole: Cheat-sheet draft by Fri morning.
alex: Legal will review Mon morning.
partners-bot: Reminder set: review meeting scheduled 2081238000 (calendar event) — "SI co-sell / HW marketplace pre-announce"
ellie: Thanks — we'll triage edge cases in the doc. If anyone sees account overlaps, post here with case id and I'll adjudicate. :thumbsup:
